The game needs three libraries from the internet (Three.js, React, Tailwind). Each one is tried on several different servers before giving up, so this message means all of them were unreachable.

By far the most common cause is opening the file inside an app's built-in preview window (a chat app, file manager or downloads pop-up), which blocks outside scripts. Open the file in a real browser such as Chrome instead. Otherwise: check the connection, or an ad/script blocker, VPN or firewall.
